camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeClusterInfoList --region cn-hangzhou --Type containerNetwork --TargetType Cluster
description_en: Queries the information about a cluster
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-cluster-info-list --type containerNetwork --target-type Cluster --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClusterInfoList

parameters.help_en:
The type of the feature. Valid values:

containerNetwork: container network
interceptionSwitch: cluster microsegmentation
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型。取值：
containerNetwork：容器网络
interceptionSwitch：集群微隔离
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The dimension based on which you want to configure the feature. Valid values:

Cluster: the ID of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
目标开关的配置的操作维度。取值：
Cluster：集群ID
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The operation value. The value specifies the ID of the cluster
parameters.help_zh: 目标开关的配置的操作值。该值表示集群ID
parameters.name: target

ClusterList.description_en: An array that consists of the information about clusters

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the container cluster

ClusterName.description_en: The name of the container cluster

ClusterType.description_en:
The type of the cluster. Valid values:

ManagedKubernetes: managed Kubernetes cluster.
NotManagedKubernetes: non-managed Kubernetes cluster.
PrivateKubernetes: private cluster.
kubernetes: dedicated Kubernetes cluster.
ask: dedicated serverless Kubernetes (ASK) cluster
ClusterType.description_zh:
集群类型。取值：

ManagedKubernetes：kubernetes托管版
NotManagedKubernetes：kubernetes非托管版
PrivateKubernetes：私有集群
kubernetes：kubernetes专有版
ask：ask专有版

RegionId.description_en: The region in which the cluster resides

State.description_en:
The status of the cluster. Valid values:

unavailable: The cluster is unavailable.
Available: The cluster is available.
Creating: The cluster is being created.
CreateFailed: The cluster failed to be created
State.description_zh:
是否可用。取值：

unavailable：不可用
Available：可用
Creating：创建中
CreateFailed：创建失败

TargetResult.description_en:
Indicates whether container network topology was enabled. Valid values:

true
false
TargetResult.description_zh:
集群开关。

true：开
false：关

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
